definitions.gloss: acquisition cost; purchase cost; cost basis
definitions.explanation: The total amount originally paid to acquire an asset such as land, a building, or shares, including related fees. When the asset is later sold, this figure is subtracted from the sale price to calculate the taxable gain.

examples.japanese: {土地|とち}の{取得費|しゅとくひ}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To look up the acquisition cost of the land.

examples.japanese: {取得費|しゅとくひ}が{分|わ}からないと、{税金|ぜいきん}の{計算|けいさん}ができない。
examples.english: If you don't know the acquisition cost, you can't calculate the tax.

examples.japanese: {売却|ばいきゃく}{価格|かかく}から{取得費|しゅとくひ}と{手数料|てすうりょう}を{引|ひ}いた{金額|きんがく}が{利益|りえき}になる。
examples.english: The profit is the sale price minus the acquisition cost and the fees.

notes:
{取得|しゅとく} (acquisition) + {費|ひ} (cost, expense). Mainly a tax and accounting term; in everyday conversation people say {買|か}った{値段|ねだん} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取得費|しゅとくひ}を{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く: to deduct the acquisition cost
- {取得費|しゅとくひ}が{不明|ふめい}: the acquisition cost is unknown
- {取得費|しゅとくひ}に{含|ふく}める: to include in the acquisition cost

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {購入費|こうにゅうひ}: purchase expense — the everyday cost of buying something, without the tax-calculation sense
- {譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}: transfer expenses — the costs of *selling*, deducted alongside the acquisition cost
